name: Onii-chan, Erande yo! ~Kyuu ni Kawaii Mitsugo no Imouto ga Yattekite Chou Yabai~
original_name: おにいちゃん、えらんでよ！ ～急に可愛い三つ子の妹がやってきて超ヤバい～
source:
I, Sekijima Kaoru, live under the same roof with three beautiful triplets.
My father's new wife has three daughters, all triplets.

Everyone is jealous of me for living with triplets... But it comes with its own challenges.
Right now...I've been confessed to by the three of them "at the same time."

The eldest sister, Mika, the second sister, Miki, and the third sister, Miku.

I love all three of them, but choosing just one of them...
"If we love Kaoru, and Kaoru loves all three of us, then we're already lovers."

"In that case, the only thing left to consider is physical compatibility, right?"
Huh? W-What do you mean?

"So you want Kaoru to appraise us. Our bodies..."

The three sisters slowly approached me, surrounding me.

"Don't worry."

"I'll take responsibility."
"Kaoru, you just need to concentrate on us."
The identical triplets each put their hands on their clothes as if to show me off.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=947656]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
我，关岛薰，和三个美丽的三胞胎住在同一屋檐下。
我父亲的新婚妻子有三个女儿，都是三胞胎。

每个人都嫉妒我和三胞胎住在一起……但这也带来了挑战。
现在……他们三个人“同时”向我表白了。

大姐美嘉，二姐美木，三姐美九。

这三个我都喜欢，但是只选其中一个……
“如果我们爱薰，而薰也爱我们三个，那么我们就已经是恋人了。”

“既然如此，那就只剩下物理兼容性了，对吧？”
啊？你-什么意思？

“所以你想让薰来鉴定一下我们。我们的身体……”

三姐妹慢慢靠近我，将我围住。

“不用担心。”

“我会承担责任。”
“薰，你只要专注于我们就可以了。”
一模一样的三胞胎都把手放在衣服上，好像在向我炫耀。

[来自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=947656]Getchu[/url]]
